question: Riya starts from Point P and drives 8 km towards the south. Then she takes a right turn, drives 11 km, she turns right again and drives 14 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 15 km. Then she takes left turn and drives 2 km, she takes a left turn again and drives 4 km and stops at Point Q. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point P again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Riya starts from Point P and drives 8 km towards the south.

 
• Then she takes a right turn, drives 11 km, she turns right again and drives 14 km.
 
• She then takes a right turn and drives 15 km.
 
• Then she takes left turn and drives 2 km, she takes a left turn again and drives 4 km and stops at Point Q
